writeGate: No frozen source/test/inventory edits until the R7 full suite has exited and its post-run integrity evidence is captured; coordinator must explicitly release writes.

findings.repair: Bind to the independently reviewed shipped guard; preserve all privacy and app-role checks.

findings.classification: confirmed stale workbench boundary hash after reviewed expiry repair
findings.repair: Refresh only exact reviewed boundary metadata, preserving strict hash, mapping, authorization and negative checks.

findings.classification: research completion refresh assertion failed only in full run; cause must be established
findings.repair: Diagnose actual request identity and response ordering; preserve task completion and rendered-state assertions. A real state regression requires product-defect escalation.

findings.classification: 120 second timeout; missed transient busy state suspected, not yet proven
findings.repair: Read-only diagnosis until separately owned with explicit source provenance; prefer deterministic fixture response control if confirmed.

acceptance: Record original full-run exact counts, failures and unchanged candidate hashes.
Focused actual behavior passes without weakening assertions, ownership checks or external-action policy.
All changed inherited source/test paths retain an explicit authorized provenance delta.
Fresh complete test-inclusive candidate and independent full-suite replay; retain all prior failures.
constraints: No providers, mail, deployment, destructive migrations or git history mutation
